title: Bellman Ford Algorithm
problemStatement: Single-source shortest paths with possible negative edge weights; detect negative cycles reachable from source.
intuition: Relax all edges |V|-1 times. A further improvement ⇒ negative cycle. Slower than Dijkstra but more general.

approaches.title: Only Dijkstra (trap)
approaches.idea: Tempting if you ignore negatives — incorrect.
approaches.code: # Do NOT use Dijkstra when negative weights exist.

approaches.title: Optimal: Bellman-Ford
approaches.idea: Initialize dist[src]=0; relax edges n-1 times; one more pass for cycle detect.
limitations: Dense graphs: prefer Floyd or Johnson carefully

patternRecognition: Negatives or cycle detection on weighted graphs
interviewInsight: Say when you refuse Dijkstra — negative edges / cycle detect requirement.
